## Course materials (R)

**Analysis of Experiments (UFLA)**\
R scripts and exercise lists (9 problem sets) on experimental design and analysis of variance.\
[[]{.bi .bi-github} GitHub](https://github.com/raruizc/ExperimentAnalysis){.btn-pill}

**Spatial Analysis (UFLA)**\
Scripts, data and exercises in three parts: areal data, point patterns and geostatistics.\
[[]{.bi .bi-github} GitHub](https://github.com/raruizc/SpatialAnalysisCourse){.btn-pill}
